'''Colla Designs''' was the think-tank behind some of the [[Colicoid Creation Nest/Legends|Colicoid Creation Nest's]] most infamous products. Based on [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]], Colla Designs worked in conjunction with [[Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries/Legends|Phlac-Arphocc Automata Industries]] to design the [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighter]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
